tagline: Premium craft beer, hard seltzer, and spirits producer with diversified portfolio across multiple owned brands and production facilities
hero_kpi_rationale: Exceptional operational growth of 90.7% year-over-year, driven by gross margin improvement, absence of asset impairment charges of $42.6M and contract settlement fees of $26M present in 2024, as well as operational efficiency savings

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.description: Company net revenue for fiscal year 2025
kpis.signal: Revenue decline of $47.9M due to decreased sales volumes in certain brands (Twisted Tea, Truly Hard Seltzer, Samuel Adams) of $94.8M, partially offset by price increases of $27.1M and improved product mix of $19.1M

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Company gross margin for fiscal year 2025
kpis.signal: Significant gross margin improvement from 44.4% to 48.5% driven by renegotiated contract savings and recipe optimization of $37.4M or $5.24 per barrel, brewery efficiency improvements of $34.1M or $4.78 per barrel, reduction in inventory obsolescence of $10.3M and lower third-party production costs of $9.6M, partially offset by inflationary and tariff impacts of $36.8M or $5.15 per barrel

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Company operating income for fiscal year 2025
kpis.signal: Dramatic increase in operating income of $68.9M driven by gross margin improvement of $58.8M, absence of intangible asset impairment charges of $42.6M (present in 2024 following Dogfish Head valuation revision) and absence of contract settlement fees of $26.0M recorded in 2024, partially offset by increase in advertising and selling expenses of $57.9M
